notes.title: Pounce Cat V1.07
notes.content:
Minor bug fix

 - Fixed an issue that allowed players to cancel momentum halfway through a jump.

notes.title: Bug fixes for Pounce Cat V1.05
notes.content:
Big fixes:
- Fixed a bug causing the walk animation to play at a slower than normal speed after a fully charged jump
- Fixed an issue that cause the wiggle animation to play at the incorrect speed

Miscellaneous fixes:
- Fixed an issue where the windmill wasn't aligned with the tiles correctly

notes.title: Pounce Cat Patch V1.01
notes.content:
Features:

- Added native controller support within the game

Bugs:

- Fixed an issue where animations would occur incorrectly or in the wrong order
- Fixed an issue where falling off a ledge during a jump would cause the player to become stuck until 
  another jump was made
- Fixed an issue where the wiggle animation would not play if the direction of movement changed at the 
  same time the jump button was pressed

Misc fixes:

- Fixed some tiles in the world behaving incorrectly
- Corrected some inconsistencies in tile placement throughout the game
